test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II (AAO) 2023 Official Paper-III (Held On: 27 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: With respect to the monetary policy, which of the following statements is INCORRECT?

options.text: The contractionary policy decreases the total supply of money in the economy by increasing the interest rates.
There are two types of monetary policy, that is, expansionary policy and contractionary policy.
The expansionary policy works by increasing the total supply of money in the economy.
The contractionary policy boosts the economic activity during slowdowns or recessions.

solution:
The correct answer is** The contractionary policy boosts the economic activity during slowdowns or recessions.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **The contractionary policy boosts the economic activity during slowdowns or recessions:**

 
 
• This statement is incorrect. Contractionary monetary policy is designed to reduce the total supply of money in the economy, primarily by increasing interest rates. Its main objective is to control inflation, not to boost economic activity during slowdowns or recessions.
 
• During economic slowdowns or recessions, expansionary monetary policy is typically used to stimulate economic activity by lowering interest rates and increasing the money supply.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The contractionary policy decreases the total supply of money in the economy by increasing the interest rates:**

 
 
• This statement is correct. Contractionary policy aims to reduce the money supply and curb inflation by raising interest rates, making borrowing more expensive and saving more attractive.
 
 
 
• **There are two types of monetary policy, that is, expansionary policy and contractionary policy:**
 
 
• This statement is correct. Monetary policy can generally be categorized into two types: expansionary (aimed at increasing the money supply to stimulate the economy) and contractionary (aimed at decreasing the money supply to control inflation).
 
 
 
• **The expansionary policy works by increasing the total supply of money in the economy:**
 
 
• This statement is correct. Expansionary monetary policy involves lowering interest rates and increasing the money supply to encourage borrowing, spending, and investment, thereby stimulating economic growth.
